answers.question: Summarize Deccan's FY 2025-26 MCA Form AOC-4 financial health, the CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b) disputed Maharashtra GST demand & pre-deposit, SBI Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 DSCR covenant, and Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Summarize Deccan's FY 2025-26 MCA Form AOC-4 financial health, the CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b) disputed Maharashtra GST demand & pre-deposit, SBI Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 DSCR covenant, and Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Deccan is financially sound and covenant-compliant. Statutory auditors issued an unmodified (clean) opinion, with the GST dispute and warranty disclosures carrying no qualification. The SBI sanction terms and CHG-1 charge govern any equity or control change.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: CARO 2020 Para 3(vii)(b) discloses one disputed Maharashtra GST demand (Order-in-Original dated Nov 19, 2025, FY 2022-23), treated as an off-balance-sheet contingent liability backed by Big-4 counsel opinion of ≥75% success probability. The 10% pre-deposit under Section 107(6) secures an automatic stay pending GSTAT Mumbai Bench adjudication. SBI Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 prohibits equity allotment above 25.0% dilution or foreign strategic stake entry without prior written NOC. Note 21's utilization reflects a voluntary Q2 FY26 service bulletin across 3,100 Gen-1 inverter packs.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Revenue INR 312.40 Cr (+24.80% YoY); EBITDA INR 28.60 Cr (9.15%); PAT INR 14.90 Cr; net worth INR 74.10 Cr, borrowings INR 38.40 Cr. The disputed GST amount is INR 6.85 Cr (INR 4.60 Cr tax principal plus interest and penalty); pre-deposit is INR 0.685 Cr, leaving INR 6.165 Cr stayed. DSCR is 1.62x against the ≥1.40x covenant; TOL/TNW is 1.12x against ≤1.75x. Closing warranty reserve is INR 2.85 Cr (~0.91% of revenue), and there were zero thermal runaway incidents or BIS notices.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Under Side Letter SL.1, before any KroneVolt 26.0% share allotment, Deccan must deliver SBI's written NOC under Clause 14.3 at least 5 business days prior. That NOC is a condition of NovaMart's waiver of MSA Clause 11.4 rights, including the INR 3.80 Cr tooling clawback.

answers.question: Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Schedule C (REG-BIS-EPR-2026) controls. SKU NM-LFP-1200W's cell chemistry is governed under IS 16046 (Part 2): 2018 / IEC 62133-2, under BIS CRS Registration No. R-41209877. CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expires December 31, 2026. The 1,200 Wh pack exceeds the 100 Wh IATA PI 965 threshold by 12x, so it is UN 3480 Class 9.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause C.2 sets the gate. If renewed FY27 EPR credentials are not verified on NovaMart's portal by 18:00 IST on December 10, 2026, NovaMart may automatically delist, suppress Buy-Box visibility, and inventory-freeze all Deccan battery and appliance ASINs effective December 15, 2026, without penalty, notice period, or breach liability. Under Clause C.3(a), Deccan is prohibited from tendering SKU NM-LFP-1200W on any NovaMart Air Express or belly-cargo manifest. Dispatch must go by DG-certified surface linehaul, with packs at SoC ≤ 30%.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Misdeclaration triggers INR 5,00,000 per consignment in liquidated indemnity plus DGCA reporting. BIS CRS non-conformity and UN 3480 shipping violations are uncapped under Clause 9.2(b), outside the Clause 9.1 cap. Deccan must also hold at least INR 25,00,00,000 per occurrence in product liability cover. The CPCB covenants arise under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 and E-Waste Rules, 2022.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Deccan must deliver CPCB portal renewal confirmation and quarterly Form-3 credits by December 10, 2026. NABL lab renewals and BIS surveillance reports must be uploaded to the Compliance Vault at least 15 days before SKU launch. Banking NOC or escrow gate: none stated in the text provided.

answers.question: Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: These are four distinct, layered adjustments, and the later instruments override the MSA where they say so. Addendum A Clause A.4 supersedes the baseline 2.0% MSA cap for Festive Peak. Side Letter SL.2 expressly overrides the unconditional 24-month MSA Clause 5.4 exclusivity. The 3.25% SL.3 ceiling expressly excludes Peak SLA damages and Schedule D GST escrow/debit adjustments, so those are not netted against it.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 3 CD: NovaMart's sole treasury election, NEFT/RTGS within T+10 days of GRN, deducted from net remittance via SAP clearing. A.4(c): peak cap overrides the baseline monthly cap, settled by GST Credit Note after weekly variance reconciliation. SL.2: exclusivity expires at 9 months (Dec 31, 2026) unless INR 85.00 Cr of binding POs by Sept 30, 2027, with INR 42.00 Cr by Dec 31, 2026. Failure frees Deccan to supply competing marketplaces, with no refund of unamortized tooling advances. SL.3 rebates are reconciled within 30 days after March 31.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: CD: flat 1.75%. Baseline LDs: 0.50% per full point below 96.5% OTIF, capped at 2.0% of monthly invoiced PO value. Peak: INR 1,250 per pallet-hour, 3.50% flash-sale deduction, capped at 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value. At risk on exclusivity: the INR 3.80 Crore tooling advance. Rebates: 1.50% (INR 50 Cr), 2.75% (INR 85 Cr), 3.50% (INR 120 Cr). Clawback ceiling: 3.25% of realized annual net purchases. T+43 settlement preserves the Section 43B(h) deduction.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: None stated in the text provided.

answers.question: What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Under Clause 9.1, each party's 12-month aggregate liability is capped at the GREATER OF INR 4,50,00,000 (INR 4.50 Cr) or 100% of trailing-12-month net GMV wholesale payouts. Clause 9.2 carves out three uncapped areas: Schedule B (DPDP/CERT-In), Schedule C (BIS/UN 3480/recall), and Schedule D (GST/ITC). Under SL.4, Schedules B, C and D remain untouched and fully enforceable alongside the Clause 9.2 carve-outs.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: B.4 states the INR 4.50 Cr cap does NOT apply to Schedule B breaches. C.4 requires a pre-funded 48-hour recall, and Deccan bears uncapped liability for refunds, hazardous-disposal fees, rack remediation, bodily injury and fire damage. D.4 makes the ITC indemnity under CGST Sec 16(2)(c)/Sec 74 UNCAPPED, surviving expiry for eight years. SL.2 exclusivity non-fulfilment never impairs the uncapped indemnity, recall rights or 8-year GST survival.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: DPDP penalties can reach statutory maximums of INR 250 Crore (security safeguard failures) and INR 200 Crore (failure to notify). Cyber-risk insurance of at least INR 15.00 Crore must cover IoT telemetry incidents. Product liability insurance of at least INR 25,00,00,000 per occurrence is required, naming NovaMart as Additional Insured and Loss Payee. Schedule D places short-levy and ITC-loss exposure 100% on Deccan; no INR ceiling is stated.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: None stated in the text provided. Insurance minimums (INR 15.00 Cr cyber, INR 25 Cr CGL) are covenants, but no execution gate, banking NOC, or escrow condition appears in the text provided.

answers.question: During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes, Addendum A controls. During the Festive Peak Window (October 10 – November 15, 2026), Clauses A.2–A.5 expressly override and supersede baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6. It applies automatically without annual re-execution. Baseline terms resume at 00:00 IST on November 16, 2026.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under A.2, OTIF rises from the 96.5% baseline to 98.8%, measured weekly (not monthly) with zero carry-over credit. Trucks must check in within ±30 minutes of the booked dock slot. The baseline tolerance was ±120 minutes, with rescheduling at zero demurrage. Under A.5, regional/state transporter strikes, highway bandhs and similar events lasting fewer than 72 consecutive hours are NOT Force Majeure, versus the baseline 24-hour threshold. Even beyond 72 hours, Deccan must show it activated two pre-contracted dedicated fleets within 8 hours and exhausted the Peenya/Bhiwandi buffer units.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: A.4(a): INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour, regardless of carrier fault unless excused beyond 72 hours. A.4(b): an instant 3.50% invoice deduction on the unfulfilled PO tranche where a Hero Deal slot is delisted. A.4(c): a combined cap of 6.50% of total Festive Peak PO landed value, overriding the 2.0% monthly cap, settled via GST Credit Note adjustment. The baseline was 0.50% per percentage point shortfall, capped at 2.0%. No statutory-section figures (DPDP, CERT-In, MSMED, etc.) appear in the text provided.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: A buffer-staging gate under A.3: by October 5, 2026, Deccan must pre-position 4,500 units of NM-LFP-1200W and 9,000 units of NM-AIR-H14, split 55%/45% across Peenya and Bhiwandi. No banking NOC, escrow, or delisting gate is stated in the text provided.

answers.question: Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes, in the base case. Clause 11.4 is triggered by a transfer of 25.0% or more of fully diluted voting capital to a foreign strategic entity, and KroneVolt's stake is 26.0%. Absent express written waiver before closing, NovaMart may terminate immediately on notice. However, Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09) directly modifies MSA Clause 11.4 and conditionally waives termination rights, strictly contingent on two Conditions Precedent.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under SL.1, the two Conditions Precedent are: (1) a certified copy of SBI's written NOC satisfying Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 under MCA Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129, delivered at least 5 business days before share allotment; and (2) an absolute telemetry firewall: no API keys, bulk telemetry exports, or remote SSH access to Indian customer IoT data or AWS ap-south-1/ap-south-2 KMS realms for KroneVolt, its Munich engineers, or its nominee director (Schedule B, Clause B.2). SL.2 overrides MSA Clause 5.4: NM-LFP-1200W exclusivity automatically expires at 9 months (effective December 31, 2026) unless NovaMart issues binding, non-cancellable POs aggregating at least INR 85.00 Crore by 23:59 IST on September 30, 2027, including INR 42.00 Crore by December 31, 2026.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Waived exposure is the INR 3.80 Cr tooling clawback. The round is INR 65.00 Crore. SBI facilities total INR 45.00 Crore (INR 35.00 Cr fund-based plus INR 10.00 Cr non-fund-based), and Clause 14.3 prohibits equity allotment above 25.0% dilution or foreign strategic stake entry without SBI's prior written NOC. If NovaMart misses either gate, Deccan may supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP OEM variants to competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: The SBI NOC certified copy, delivered at least 5 business days before share allotment, plus the telemetry firewall, which operates as a continuing condition before allotment. The text provided states no escrow or delisting gate.

answers.question: Under Schedule B (DPDP Act 2023), where must Indian smart-appliance IoT telemetry and KMS keys reside, and what are Deccan's exact 4-hour CERT-In feeder, 24-hour key rotation, and 72-hour DPB breach timelines?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule B (DPDP Act 2023), where must Indian smart-appliance IoT telemetry and KMS keys reside, and what are Deccan's exact 4-hour CERT-In feeder, 24-hour key rotation, and 72-hour DPB breach timelines?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Deccan must ingest, store, and process 100% of raw IoT telemetry exclusively in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai), with ap-south-2 (Hyderabad) as DR failover, encrypted with NovaMart-controlled CMKs in AWS KMS. Offshore replication or shareholder access requires NovaMart's prior written CISO & DPO authorization. Schedule B breaches sit outside the MSA liability cap.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause B.2(a): 90-day automatic CMK rotation, TLS 1.3 in transit, and AWS SCP guardrails blocking cross-region S3 replication or EBS snapshot sharing. Clause B.3: preliminary incident packet to NovaMart SOC within 4 consecutive hours of detection, against CERT-In's 6-hour reporting window. Within 24 hours, revoke compromised X.509 MQTT certificates, broker credentials, and signing keys. Within 72 hours, deliver a forensic root-cause dossier so NovaMart can file DPB and Data Principal notifications. Side Letter SL.1 reinforces: KroneVolt gets no API keys, telemetry exports, or SSH access to ap-south-1/2 KMS realms.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The INR 4.50 Crore liability cap does not apply to Schedule B breaches. Deccan indemnifies 100% of DPB penalties: up to INR 250 Crore for security-safeguard failures, and up to INR 200 Crore for failure to notify. Minimum cyber-insurance is INR 15.00 Crore. Erasure/revocation webhooks must be honored within 48 hours. The other statutory references (MSMED, CGST, MCA beyond SL.1) are not in the text provided.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: For the KroneVolt 26% stake, Deccan must deliver SBI's written NOC (Clause 14.3, CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129) at least 5 business days before share allotment, and maintain the absolute telemetry firewall. Any other gate is not in the text provided.

answers.question: If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. Clause D.2 operates a bifurcated SAP rail so a missing or mismatched invoice does not breach MSMED or 43B(h) limits. NovaMart still releases 100% of the undisputed pre-tax base principal on schedule by T+43 days from GRN, inside the 45-day MSMED/43B(h) safe harbor. Only the 18% GST component is withheld.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: D.2(b) holds the tax component (CGST 9% + SGST 9% intra-Karnataka, or IGST 18% inter-state) in a non-interest-bearing Tax Compliance Escrow Holdback Account until the invoice populates cleanly in GSTR-2B without Section 16(2)(c) supplier-default flags. Cured holdbacks (GSTR-1 IFF/amendment or DRC-03 deposit) release automatically on the following Friday AP run with zero administrative deduction. The cure window ends on the EARLIER of 180 calendar days from the original tax invoice date, or September 30 following the close of the relevant Financial Year (Rule 37A / Section 16(4) alignment).

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: If Deccan fails to cure GSTR-1 and remit GSTR-3B by the deadline, the escrowed 18% GST balance converts permanently into a non-refundable commercial debit note against Deccan's vendor ledger, plus interest recovery at 18% p.a. under CGST Section 50(3) and any Section 73/74 penalty assessed against NovaMart. Without the split design, undisputed delays beyond Day 45 accrue compound interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate under MSMED Section 16. Deccan's indemnity for Section 16(2)(c)/Section 74 ITC disallowances is uncapped and survives eight years. No INR escrow amounts are stated in the text provided.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: None stated in the text provided. The only release trigger is a clean GSTR-2B population (or DRC-03/GSTR-1 cure) before the cure deadline.

answers.question: Summarize Deccan's FY 2025-26 MCA Form AOC-4 financial health, the CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b) disputed Maharashtra GST demand & pre-deposit, SBI Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 DSCR covenant, and Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Summarize Deccan's FY 2025-26 MCA Form AOC-4 financial health, the CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b) disputed Maharashtra GST demand & pre-deposit, SBI Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 DSCR covenant, and Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Deccan is financially sound. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified (clean) opinion, with emphasis only on standard contingent disclosures in Note 18 and CARO Clause (vii)(b). Revenue was INR 312.40 Cr (+24.80% YoY), EBITDA INR 28.60 Cr (9.15%), and PAT INR 14.90 Cr. Net Debt/EBITDA is 0.89x and net worth is INR 74.10 Cr.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b) discloses one disputed Maharashtra GST order dated November 19, 2025 (FY 2022-23 IGST credits). The 10% pre-deposit under Section 107(6) secures an automatic stay of recovery pending GSTAT, Mumbai Bench. SBI covenants require DSCR >= 1.40x and TOL/TNW <= 1.75x; Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 bars >25.0% dilution or foreign strategic entry without SBI's prior written NOC. Note 21's retrofit was a voluntary Q2 FY26 service bulletin covering 3,100 Gen-1 inverter packs.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The GST demand totals INR 6.85 Cr (INR 4.60 Cr tax principal plus interest and 10% penalty, non-fraud). The pre-deposit is INR 0.685 Cr, leaving INR 6.165 Cr stayed. It is an off-balance-sheet contingency with counsel's >=75% success estimate. Audited DSCR is 1.62x and TOL/TNW 1.12x, with CC utilization of INR 27.20 Cr of the INR 45.00 Cr limit. The warranty reserve closed at INR 2.85 Cr (~0.91% of revenue), after INR 2.12 Cr of additions and INR 1.42 Cr of utilization. Note 21 confirms zero thermal runaway incidents and zero BIS notices.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: For the KroneVolt 26.0% stake, Side Letter SL.1 requires a certified copy of SBI's written NOC under Clause 14.3 at least 5 business days before share allotment, plus an absolute telemetry firewall. No gate beyond this is stated in the text provided for the GST dispute or warranty reserve.

answers.question: Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: SKU NM-LFP-1200W's cell chemistry is governed under IS 16046 (Part 2): 2018 / IEC 62133-2, under BIS CRS Registration No. R-41209877 (factory code Peenya-Unit-2). CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expires December 31, 2026. Air Express is banned because the 1,200 Wh LFP pack exceeds the 100 Wh IATA PI 965 cargo exception threshold by 12x, so it is classified UN 3480 Class 9 Dangerous Goods.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause C.1 (BIS), C.2 (EPR), C.3 (UN 3480). Under C.2, renewal confirmation and quarterly Form-3 certificates are due to Seller Compliance Ops no later than December 10, 2026. If not verified by 18:00 IST on December 10, NovaMart may automatically delist, suppress Buy-Box visibility and inventory-freeze all Deccan battery and appliance ASINs effective December 15, 2026, without penalty, notice period or breach liability. Under C.3(b), dispatches must use DG-certified surface linehaul with packs factory-discharged to SoC ≤ 30%.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Air misdeclaration triggers INR 5,00,000 per-consignment liquidated indemnity plus DGCA reporting. Recall liability is uncapped, carved out from MSA Clause 9.1 per Clause 9.2(b)(ii), backed by INR 25,00,00,000 per-occurrence liability insurance. Other statutory figures (DPDP, MSMED, CGST) are not implicated by these three questions.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: BIS: NABL lab renewal and BIS surveillance inspection reports must be uploaded to the Compliance Vault at least 15 days before SKU launch. EPR: renewal verified on the portal by 18:00 IST, December 10, 2026. Transport: a valid UN 38.3 Test Summary attached to the GST e-Way Bill. A banking NOC or escrow gate is not stated in the text provided.

answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: These adjustments are not one stack. Addendum A's 6.50% peak cap explicitly overrides the baseline 2.0% monthly cap in MSA Clause 4. Side Letter SL.2 expressly overrides MSA Clause 5.4's unconditional 24-month exclusivity. SL.3's 3.25% ceiling expressly excludes Peak SLA liquidated damages under Clause A.4 and Schedule D GST escrow/debit adjustments, so peak penalties sit outside it.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 3: invoices paid by NEFT/RTGS within T+10 days of GRN earn a flat 1.75% CD, at NovaMart's sole treasury election. A.4: INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour, plus an instant 3.50% deduction on the unfulfilled PO tranche when a Hero Deal slot is delisted; settled via GST Credit Note after weekly variance reconciliation. SL.2: exclusivity ends at 9 months (December 31, 2026) unless binding POs reach INR 85.00 Crore by September 30, 2027, with INR 42.00 Crore by December 31, 2026. SL.3 rebates are reconciled within 30 days after March 31.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: CD 1.75%; peak cap 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value versus 2.0% baseline; rebates are 1.50% above INR 50 Crore, 2.75% above INR 85 Crore and 3.50% above INR 120 Crore; promotional and clawback charges are capped at 3.25% of realized annual net wholesale purchases. If either exclusivity gate is missed, Deccan may supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP variants to competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances. The T+43 payment term keeps a 2-day buffer inside the Section 15 MSMED 45-day ceiling; later undisputed delays accrue interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: None stated in the text provided.

answers.question: What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Clause 9.1's cap is the GREATER OF INR 4,50,00,000 (INR 4.50 Cr) or 100% of trailing-12-month net GMV wholesale payouts, and is "subject strictly to Clause 9.2." Clause 9.2 expressly overrides both Clause 9.1 and Clause 8 for three schedules: B (DPDP/CERT-In), C (BIS/UN 3480/recall), and D (GST/ITC).

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 9.2(i) covers Schedule B (DPA-DPDP-2026), 9.2(ii) covers Schedule C (REG-BIS-EPR-2026), and 9.2(iii) covers Schedule D (TAX-GST-ITC-2026). Clause B.4 confirms the INR 4.50 Cr cap does not apply to Schedule B breaches. Clause C.4 requires a pre-funded, 100% supplier-funded recall within 48 hours and carves out uncapped liability for refunds, hazardous-disposal fees, bodily injury and fire damage. Clause D.4 makes the ITC/Section 74 indemnity uncapped and surviving eight (8) years after expiry.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: DPDP penalty exposure reaches up to INR 250 Crore (security safeguards) and up to INR 200 Crore (failure to notify), plus CERT-In audit fees and remediation costs. Cyber-risk insurance minimum is INR 15.00 Crore. Product liability insurance must be at least INR 25,00,00,000 per occurrence. GST at 18% under HSN 85076000 and 84213990, with misclassification losses borne 100% by Deccan. No separate INR ceiling for Schedule D appears in the text provided; its liability is uncapped.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, confirm the INR 25 Cr CGL policy with an IRDAI-licensed insurer naming NovaMart Commerce India Pvt. Ltd. as Additional Insured & Loss Payee, with a 30-day non-cancellation undertaking. Also confirm the INR 15 Cr cyber cover. Quarterly independent GST tax sign-off is required for HSN verification. No banking NOC, escrow, or delisting gate is stated in the text provided.

answers.question: During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. During the Festive Peak Window (October 10 – November 15, 2026), Clauses A.2 through A.5 expressly override and supersede baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6. Addendum A applies automatically without annual re-execution. Baseline 96.5% terms resume at 00:00 IST on November 16, 2026.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause A.2 raises OTIF from 96.5% to 98.8%, measured weekly (not monthly), with zero carry-over credit. Clause A.4(a) charges INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour for missing the ±30-minute dock window or short-shipping. Clause A.4(b) imposes an instant 3.50% invoice deduction on the unfulfilled PO tranche when a Hero Deal slot is delisted. Settlement is via GST Credit Note after weekly reconciliation. Under Clause A.5, regional transporter strikes and bandhs lasting fewer than 72 consecutive hours are not Force Majeure, versus the baseline MSA Clause 6 threshold of more than 24 hours. Even beyond 72 hours, Deccan must show it activated at least two pre-contracted closed-body fleets within 8 hours and exhausted the buffer stock.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The combined peak cap is 6.50% of total Festive Peak PO landed value, replacing the baseline 2.0% monthly cap (0.50% per full point below 96.5%). That is a 4.5-percentage-point increase. Statutory sections are not in the text provided.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Operationally, Deccan must pre-position ring-fenced buffer stock (4,500 units of NM-LFP-1200W and 9,000 units of NM-AIR-H14) by October 5, 2026. No banking NOC, escrow, or delisting sign-off gate is stated in the text provided.

answers.question: Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes, but only conditionally. MSA Clause 11.4 covers equity issuances of 25.0% or more, or investor veto rights granted to a foreign strategic entity, and absent NovaMart's written waiver it permits immediate termination. KroneVolt's 26.0% exceeds that threshold. However, Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09) strictly prevails over the MSA on KroneVolt 26% Change-of-Control consent and the exclusivity thresholds.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under SL.1, NovaMart conditionally waives its termination and tooling-clawback rights, strictly contingent on two Conditions Precedent before share allotment: (1) delivery of a certified copy of SBI's written NOC satisfying Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 under MCA Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129, at least 5 business days before allotment; and (2) an absolute telemetry firewall barring KroneVolt, its Munich engineers and its nominee director from API keys, bulk telemetry exports or remote SSH access to Indian customer IoT data or AWS KMS realms (Schedule B, Clause B.2). SL.2 overrides MSA Clause 5.4's 24-month exclusivity: it expires automatically at 9 months (effective December 31, 2026) unless NovaMart issues cumulative binding POs of at least INR 85.00 Crore by September 30, 2027, including INR 42.00 Crore by December 31, 2026.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The round is INR 65.00 Crore of fresh capital for a 26.0% stake. The waived clawback is INR 3.80 Cr of unamortized tooling advances, recovered on a straight-line pro-rata basis. SBI's facilities total INR 45.00 Crore (INR 35.00 Cr fund-based plus INR 10.00 Cr non-fund-based). Clause 14.3 prohibits equity allotment above 25.0% dilution or foreign strategic stake entry without SBI's prior written NOC. If either PO gate is missed, Deccan may supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP OEM variants to competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: The SBI NOC must be delivered at least 5 business days before share allotment, and the telemetry firewall must hold continuously. Schedules B, C and D stay enforceable, and SL.2 expiry never impairs uncapped indemnification, 48-hour recall rights or 8-year GST audit survival.

answers.question: If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. Clause D.2 bifurcates the SAP payment rail, so NovaMart still releases 100% of the undisputed pre-tax base principal by T+43 days from GRN, inside the 45-day MSMED/43B(h) safe harbor. Only the 18% GST component is withheld.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under D.2(b), the GST (CGST 9% + SGST 9%, or IGST 18%) sits in a non-interest-bearing Tax Compliance Escrow Holdback Account until the invoice populates cleanly in GSTR-2B without Section 16(2)(c) default flags. Under D.3, resolved holdbacks (via GSTR-1 IFF/amendment or Form DRC-03) release automatically on the following Friday AP run with zero deduction. The cure deadline is the EARLIER of 180 calendar days from the tax invoice date or September 30 following the relevant Financial Year's close (per Rule 37A and Section 16(4)). If Deccan fails to cure GSTR-1 and remit GSTR-3B by then, the escrow converts permanently into a non-refundable commercial debit note against Deccan's vendor ledger.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The setoff carries statutory interest recovery at 18% p.a. under CGST Section 50(3), plus any Section 73/74 departmental penalty assessed against NovaMart. If NovaMart paid principal late, undisputed delays beyond Day 45 accrue compound interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate under MSMED Section 16. Blocked ITC under Section 16(2)(c)/74 and unreimbursed tax assessments are uncapped carve-outs from the Clause 9.1 cap of the greater of INR 4,50,00,000 or 100% of trailing-twelve-month net GMV payouts.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: None stated in the text provided beyond the operational gate that escrow release requires a clean GSTR-2B population (no Section 16(2)(c) supplier-default flags). No banking NOC or delisting gate appears in the text provided.

answers.question: Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: SKU NM-LFP-1200W's cell chemistry is governed under IS 16046 (Part 2): 2018 / IEC 62133-2, under BIS CRS Registration No. R-41209877. CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expires December 31, 2026. Air Express is banned because the 1,200 Wh pack exceeds the 100 Wh IATA PI 965 exception threshold by 12x and is classified UN 3480 Class 9 Dangerous Goods.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under C.2, Deccan must submit CPCB portal renewal confirmation plus quarterly Form-3 credits no later than December 10, 2026. If not verified by 18:00 IST on December 10, NovaMart may automatically delist, suppress Buy-Box and inventory-freeze all Deccan battery and appliance ASINs effective December 15, 2026, without penalty, notice period or breach liability. Under C.3(a), Deccan is prohibited from tendering the SKU on any NovaMart Air Express, belly-cargo or priority air-courier manifest. C.3(b) requires DG-certified surface linehaul with every pack discharged to SoC ≤ 30% and a UN 38.3 summary attached to the e-Way Bill.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Misdeclaration triggers INR 5,00,000 per-consignment liquidated indemnity plus DGCA reporting. The delisting carries no penalty or breach liability for NovaMart. Related recall exposure is uncapped, carved out of MSA Clause 9.1 per Clause 9.2(b)(ii), backed by at least INR 25,00,00,000 per-occurrence insurance.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Verified FY27 EPR renewal on NovaMart's portal by 18:00 IST, December 10, 2026 (per C.2). Also, per C.1, valid NABL lab and BIS surveillance reports must be uploaded to the Compliance Vault at least 15 days before SKU launch. Banking NOC or escrow gates: none stated in the text provided.

answers.question: Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: The four adjustments run on separate tracks and do not net against one another. For the Peak Window, Addendum A Clauses A.2–A.5 expressly override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 from October 10 to November 15, 2026. Side Letter SL.2 expressly overrides the unconditional 24-month exclusivity in MSA Clause 5.4. The SL.3 ceiling expressly excludes Peak SLA liquidated damages under Clause A.4.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 3 CD: at NovaMart's sole treasury election, NEFT/RTGS settlement within T+10 days of GRN earns a flat 1.75% CD, versus the Net T+43 base term from GRN. Clause A.4: fees and deductions are capped at 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value, overriding the baseline 2.0% monthly cap, settled by GST Credit Note after weekly reconciliation. SL.2: exclusivity expires at 9 months (Dec 31, 2026) unless binding POs total INR 85.00 Cr by Sept 30, 2027, with INR 42.00 Cr by Dec 31, 2026. SL.3: promotional co-op fees, banner charges, marketing deductions and rebate clawbacks are capped at 3.25% of annual net purchases.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Peak delay fee: INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour; flash-sale delisting: 3.50% instant invoice deduction. Rebate ladder: 1.50% at INR 50 Cr, 2.75% at INR 85 Cr, 3.50% at INR 120 Cr. Missing either SL.2 gate means Deccan may supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP variants to competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances. Statutory: delays beyond Day 45 accrue compound interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate; the T+43 term preserves the Section 43B(h) deduction.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: None stated in the text provided.

[DOC-02#c03 · Clause A.4 (INR 1,250/Pallet-Hr & 6.5% Peak Penalty Cap)]
CLAUSE A.4 (PEAK LIQUIDATED DAMAGES ESCALATOR — SUPERSEDING 2.0% MSA CAP): Recognizing that stockouts during Diwali Flash-Sale Hero Slots cause irreversible customer acquisition and paid-search ad-spend loss, shortfalls during the Festive Peak Window trigger tiered remedies replacing baseline Clause 4.2:
(a) Dock Detention & Late Linehaul Fee: Inbound deliveries missing the +/- 30-minute WMS dock window or arriving short-shipped incur INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour (billed in 60-minute increments per stalled bay allocation, regardless of carrier fault unless excused beyond 72 hours under Clause A.5).

citations.cited_text: (b) Instant Flash-Sale Unfulfilled Deduction: Where short-delivery or late replenishment forces NovaMart to delist a promoted Hero Deal homepage slot, Deccan incurs an instant 3.50% commercial invoice deduction on the unfulfilled PO tranche.

citations.cited_text:
[DOC-07#c03 · Clause SL.3 (Volume Rebate Tiers & 3.25% Promotional Clawback Cap)]
CLAUSE SL.3 (BACK-END VOLUME REBATES & 3.25% CLAWBACK CEILING): In connection with KroneVolt's incoming institutional board governance and working-capital debt-coverage covenants, annual back-end volume growth rebates payable by Deccan to NovaMart apply on a strictly progressive annual net-purchase ladder reconciled within 30 days after March 31 fiscal close: 1.50% upon crossing INR 50.00 Crore, 2.75% upon crossing INR 85.00 Crore, and 3.50% upon crossing INR 120.00 Crore in cumulative annual net invoiced PO value (settled via CGST Section 34 commercial/tax credit notes).
